expected_savings_if_tips_followed.message: Homes that follow energy tips typically use 4-7% less. For you that is about 9-15 kg CO2 and Rs 126-221 a month.
expected_savings_if_tips_followed.basis: Range of savings reported for household energy feedback: 4.1-6.7% (randomised trial, 1,028 homes, Da Nang, Vietnam: Nguyen, Goto, Tran & Vu, Energy Policy 195, 2024) and 7% (neighbour-comparison study in Delhi: Malaviya & Chandiwala, WRI, 2018). Larger US programmes saw about 2% (Allcott, J. Public Economics, 2011). This is what OTHER studies found, not a measured WattWise result.

peer_group.note: Peer groups come from London homes split into 4 usage bands; replaced by real app users later.

recommendation.title: Trim your daily use a little
recommendation.message: You're forecast above similar homes (7.4 kWh/day). Cutting ~0.8 kWh a day = about Rs 238 and 16 kg CO2 a month (each unit costs you Rs 10.60 at your slab).

notes: Forecast models were trained on 148 London homes (Low Carbon London, 2013); Indian homes may differ.
Bill = energy + wheeling + fixed charge (MSEDCL FY 2026-27). Electricity duty and FAC are not included.
Carbon uses one yearly average for the Indian grid (CEA, 0.727 kg CO2/kWh).
